findings.title: Async work not awaited
findings.why: eslint @typescript-eslint/no-misused-promises: Promise-returning function provided to attribute where a void return was expected.
findings.fix: `await` it, `Promise.all` it, or keep the task reference and attach a done callback that logs; `for … of` with `await` when order matters.
findings.cite: Python docs, `asyncio.create_task` (save a reference to avoid a task disappearing mid-execution); Python docs, "Coroutines and Tasks"

findings.title: Number or string on the left of `&&` in JSX
findings.why: eslint react/jsx-no-leaked-render: Potential leaked value that might cause unintentionally rendered values or rendering crashes
findings.fix: make the condition a boolean (`> 0`, `Boolean(x)`, `!!x`), or use a ternary.
findings.cite: React docs, "Conditional Rendering" (do not put numbers on the left side of `&&`)

findings.title: Absent value dereferenced
findings.why: eslint @typescript-eslint/no-unnecessary-condition, react/jsx-no-leaked-render: Unnecessary optional chain on a non-nullish value.
findings.fix: check and return 404/422, or `next(it, default)`; enable `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`; replace `!` with a real check.
findings.cite: Python docs, `re.match` (returns `None` when no match); MDN, `Array.prototype.find` (returns `undefined`)

findings.title: Query or remote call per item (N+1)
findings.why: eslint no-await-in-loop: Unexpected `await` inside a loop.
findings.fix: `select_related` (to-one) / `prefetch_related` (to-many) / `selectinload` / `include`; `WHERE id IN (…)`; a DataLoader per request in GraphQL; a batch endpoint for the browser.
findings.cite: CWE-1073; Django docs, "Database access optimization"

findings.title: Stale closure and effect dependencies
findings.why: eslint react-hooks/exhaustive-deps: React Hook useEffect has a missing dependency: 'productId'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
findings.fix: list every reactive value; use the functional updater; move non-reactive values out of the component; let the lint rule drive the list and remove disables.
findings.cite: React docs, "Synchronizing with Effects", "Removing Effect Dependencies", "Queueing a Series of State Updates"

findings.title: User-controlled text rendered as HTML

findings.cite: CWE-79; CWE-1336 (template injection)

findings.title: Stale closure and effect dependencies
findings.why: eslint react-hooks/exhaustive-deps: React Hook useEffect has a missing dependency: 'updatedAt'. Either include it or remove the dependency array. If 'setLabel' needs the current value of 'updatedAt', you can also switch to useReducer instead of useState and read 'updatedAt' in the reducer.
findings.fix: list every reactive value; use the functional updater; move non-reactive values out of the component; let the lint rule drive the list and remove disables.
findings.cite: React docs, "Synchronizing with Effects", "Removing Effect Dependencies", "Queueing a Series of State Updates"
